description: Properties remain largely dormant while the material approaches its responsive state.
The material enters a liquid state and becomes available for local magnetic interaction.
Volume is the predominant intended response; rigidity and large surface texture appear as coupled secondary responses.
Initial relationships weaken while delayed and indirect responses begin to emerge.
Gravity overrides volume and large texture while particle accumulation makes graduated patterns increasingly predominant.
Heat is removed; some properties re-emerge or persist and may be captured if the relevant stimuli and state conditions remain.
The solid state preserves selected properties while earlier direct and coupled associations become disconnected.
